name: Anah (son of Zibeon)
title: Horite chieftain in Edom
summary: Anah was one of the sons of the Horite Zibeon and a chieftain in the land of Edom before the Israelites. He is mentioned in the genealogy of Zibeon's descendants, known for discovering hot springs in the desert.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among the sons of Seir
keyEvents.description: Anah is listed among the sons of the Horite Seir, chieftains in Edom.
